decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the well-liked BASIC 518 trommel and was publicly renamed, so sunk investment and visible commitment strongly favour persisting despite its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021.

The multi-model flail shredder line had its own page and significant development cost, and weak visibility after the firm's restructuring can still be attributed to temporary causes, so management would keep it.

This single stationary electric fine shredder carried little sunk investment or public commitment and has not been visible since 2018, so even a commitment-prone management would release its resources to the core business.

The green-waste grinder line serves core composting and biomass customers, and after the earlier withdrawal of the related grinder C, management would want to justify keeping this line rather than admit a second failure.

The stationary pre-shredder line had its own page and underpins the announced push toward tougher stationary processing, so its centrality to the firm's direction outweighs its lack of recent web presence.
